cves.d: OpenPanel js-runtime through 2.3.0 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability in the JavaScript webhook template validator that fails to block computed member access to constructor chains. Attackers with project write access can create webhook templates using computed property notation to access Function constructor and execute arbitrary code in the worker process.

OpenPanel tracking API through 2.3.0 fails to verify client secret cryptographic hash before authorizing revenue events and bot filtering. Attackers with only a public client ID can supply arbitrary dummy secrets to inject forged revenue metrics and bypass bot detection filters.

OpenPanel through 2.3.0 fails to escape property keys in ClickHouse SQL queries, allowing authenticated users to inject boolean SQL terms. Attackers can supply crafted filter names to bypass project isolation and access metrics from other projects.

OpenPanel through 2.3.0 writes Model Context Protocol authentication tokens from URL query parameters to plaintext application logs without redaction. Attackers with access to application stdout or centralized logging systems can capture base64-encoded credentials to replay MCP requests and access project analytics.

OpenPanel through 2.3.0 share lookup procedures fail to validate access controls and return password hashes and protected report definitions to unauthenticated callers. Attackers with a share link can retrieve argon2id password hashes and full report configurations including event names, filters, and breakdown dimensions for offline password cracking and business intelligence theft.

In OpenPanel through 2.3.0, the data importer fetches a caller-supplied URL with plain fetch instead of the project's existing SSRF guard (apps/api/src/utils/safe-fetch.ts). In packages/importer/src/providers/umami.ts, parseRemoteFile calls fetch() on config.fileUrl, which is validated only by z.string().url(), so values such as http://127.0.0.1:9911/ or http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ are accepted; the shared createFileImportConfig factory gives the plausible provider the same field. An authenticated organization member — including a default 'member' with no project_access rows, for whom the intended access-level check is skipped because getProjectAccess returns boolean true rather than a level object — can therefore make the server connect to any address reachable from it. The resulting HTTP status and status text are persisted as Import.errorMessage and returned by import.get to the same user, providing a scanning oracle for internal hosts, ports and paths; if an internal response parses as Umami CSV, its rows are ingested as events and become readable in the attacker's analytics views.

OpenPanel through 2.3.0 fails to enforce read-only project access level on 26 of 29 mutating procedures, allowing read-level members to modify, delete, and publish project data. Attackers with explicit read-only access can delete reports and dashboards, schedule entire projects for deletion, publish private analytics to public share links, and modify alerting rules by exploiting missing access level validation in mutation resolvers.

OpenPanel through 2.3.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the analytics filter builder that fails to validate profile.* filter column identifiers before interpolating them into ClickHouse WHERE clauses. An authenticated attacker with project-scoped read or root export credentials can inject arbitrary ClickHouse SQL to bypass project isolation and read other organizations' analytics data and profile PII via blind boolean oracle techniques.

Openpanel before 2.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the report.getLayouts and report.resetLayout tRPC procedures that fail to bind dashboardId to the authorized projectId. Authenticated attackers can supply an arbitrary victim dashboardId with their own projectId to read report layouts and configurations or delete dashboard grid arrangements across tenants.

OpenPanel before 2.3.0 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability in the GET /tools/site-checker endpoint that accepts a fully client-controlled URL parameter with no private IP filtering or DNS-rebinding protection. Attackers can make the OpenPanel server issue requests to internal services, localhost, and cloud metadata endpoints, reading internal HTTP response titles, headers, status codes, and SSL certificate information.

A flaw was found in the buildah/copier Go package. When used outside of Buildah by a non-root caller, a crafted tar archive containing malicious symlinks can escape the target extraction directory and create files outside the intended destination. Buildah itself uses chroot hardening and is not affected.

OpenPanel before 2.3.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the unauthenticated favicon proxy endpoint GET /misc/favicon that allows remote attackers to execute scripts by supplying an SVG file URL. Attackers can host malicious SVG files with embedded scripts that execute in the victim's browser on the API origin, enabling same-origin credentialed requests to authenticated endpoints.

OpenPanel before 2.3.0 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability in the /misc/favicon and /misc/og endpoints that accept an attacker-supplied url parameter with insufficient validation. Attackers can force the API to fetch arbitrary internal hosts and cloud metadata endpoints, with small responses returned verbatim enabling credential theft and internal service enumeration.

OpenPanel before 2.3.0 contains a cross-tenant broken object level authorization vulnerability in the report.getLayouts and report.resetLayout tRPC procedures that fail to scope dashboard queries to the caller's project. Authenticated attackers can supply their own projectId with a victim organization's guessable dashboardId to read confidential report definitions or permanently delete dashboard layouts across tenant boundaries.

OpenPanel before 2.3.0 fails to properly validate chart formula expressions, allowing authenticated project members with read access to execute arbitrary code by recovering the native JavaScript Function constructor through mathjs matrix objects. Attackers can use the recovered constructor to load Node.js built-ins and execute operating system commands with the privileges of the API process, bypassing organization authorization boundaries.

Openpanel before 2.3.0 contains an unauthenticated full-read server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the GET /tools/site-checker endpoint (apps/api/src/controllers/tools.controller.ts). The endpoint passes a user-supplied url query parameter to fetchWithRedirects() and performs server-side HTTP requests to arbitrary URLs without any SSRF/IP validation. An unauthenticated remote attacker can access cloud instance metadata endpoints, probe internal services, scan internal network ports, and read returned content (status code, page size, timing, and parsed HTML metadata), and leak internal IP addresses (via getIPInfo() to a third party).

A flaw was found in crun. After pivot_root, reopening /dev/null for stdio can follow a symlink and attach a host file to container stdio, then change that file's ownership. Affected versions are crun 1.29.1 and earlier. Default configurations that mount a fresh /dev are not exposed. No fixed release is available yet.

A flaw was found in rpm. A local attacker could supply a specially crafted `.gem` filename containing RPM macro syntax. When a user or automated workflow invokes `rpmuncompress -x` on this file, the macro expansion occurs during command construction. This allows the attacker to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the invoking account, leading to a compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

A flaw was found in libdm. A local attacker could craft a malicious Logical Volume Manager (LVM) metadata configuration with deeply nested structures. This could lead to uncontrolled recursion in the libdm configuration file parser, exhausting the stack and causing any LVM command reading the metadata to crash. This vulnerability results in a Denial of Service (DoS) for affected systems.
Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in ThemeREX Group ThemeREX Addons trx_addons allows Server Side Request Forgery.This issue affects ThemeREX Addons: from n/a through 2.46.0.

Uncaught exception, improper handling of exceptional conditions, improper resource shutdown vulnerability in Apache Thrift D thrift.server.nonblocking.TNonblockingServer.



This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.25.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.25.0, which fixes the issue.

Use of uninitialized resource, Return of wrong status code vulnerability in Apache Thrift C++ WebSocket server.



This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.25.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.25.0, which fixes the issue.

The Module Manager decided whether a privileged service could dereference an object address a module named by asking only whether that address fell outside the module. The manager's object pool is outside every module, so the test was satisfied by an address shifted into the interior of one of the module's own privileged allocations, which denotes no object at all. The bytes such an address presents as a control block are bytes the module put there through ordinary create and set services, so the control block ID at the front of them could be made to read as any type the module chose, and the `_txe_` layer's ID test then agreed. The reported chain uses that to reach a privileged `memset` across an attacker-chosen range.

Zebra before 4.4.0 contains a consensus divergence vulnerability in V5 transparent signature verification, computing a ZIP-244 digest for SIGHASH_SINGLE inputs lacking corresponding outputs instead of failing. Attackers can craft V5 transactions with fewer outputs than inputs that Zebra accepts and templates via getblocktemplate, producing blocks zcashd rejects.

Zebra before 6.3.0 contains an improper exceptional condition check in ChainSync::obtain_tips that discards valid one-hash FindBlocks responses, falsely reporting close-to-tip status. Peers returning only the next block hash cause a zero-length sync sample, making the /ready endpoint return 200 OK while the node remains behind the tip.

The getblock RPC method in zebra-rpc before 11.0.0, used by the Zcash Foundation's Zebra node, panics on verbosity 2 for a side-chain block because the block's -1 confirmations sentinel is converted to u32 with .expect(), aborting the process. Remote unauthenticated attackers, directly or through lightwalletd, can repeat this call to keep the node in a crash loop.

Zebra before 6.1.0 contains an incomplete cleanup vulnerability in the state write task that allows remote unauthenticated peers to stall node synchronization by poisoning parent_error_map. Attackers can deliver a coinbase-malleated block sharing a canonical block's hash before it propagates, causing the next canonical block to be rejected and stalling the node for roughly 2,000 blocks.

Zebra before 6.1.0 contains an incorrect calculation vulnerability in its ZIP-317 block template selector that omits header and transaction-count size from the block budget. Attackers can place valid selectable transactions in a victim miner's mempool to shape templates into oversized blocks, causing rejection and wasted proof-of-work.

Zebra before 6.3.0 contains a protection mechanism failure that allows unauthenticated peers to evade misbehavior scoring by supplying invalid gossiped blocks. The inbound cleanup step wrongly downcasts RouterError to VerifyBlockError and discards the score, so attackers can repeatedly force block download and Equihash verification without being banned.

Zebra (zebrad) 4.5.0 before 6.3.0 discards which peer supplied the block hashes in FindBlocks responses, then assigns 100 misbehavior points, the ban threshold, to whichever peer serves a requested block more than 50,000 heights above the tip. A remote peer can return real far-ahead hashes to a syncing node so that honest peers get banned, eroding its peer set and raising eclipse risk.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

btrfs: tree-checker: validate names in ROOT_REF and ROOT_BACKREF

ROOT_REF and ROOT_BACKREF items contain a struct btrfs_root_ref followed
by the subvolume name. Several readers assume that this layout is already
valid and then use the on-disk name length directly. A corrupted item can
therefore make those readers address bytes outside the item, and
BTRFS_IOC_GET_SUBVOL_INFO can copy too many bytes into its fixed-size UAPI
name buffer.

Validate ROOT_REF and ROOT_BACKREF items in tree-checker before any reader
uses them. Reject records that do not contain a non-empty name, whose
name_len does not exactly describe the remaining item payload, or whose
name exceeds BTRFS_NAME_LEN.

For BTRFS_IOC_GET_SUBVOL_INFO, copy only the validated on-disk name_len
instead of deriving the copy length from the item size. The ioctl result is

The DevKit Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass Leading to Administrator Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.0 This is due to the `revert_switch` handler trusting the attacker-controlled `original_user_id` cookie as the privileged identity: `verify_nonce_and_capability()` incorrectly checks the `manage_options` capability on the user identified by the cookie rather than on the actual requester via `current_user_can()`, while the switch-back form and a valid session-bound nonce are emitted publicly via `wp_footer` to any visitor — including unauthenticated users — whenever that cookie is present. A vulnerability was found in Undertow. This vulnerability impacts a server that supports the wildfly-http-client protocol. Whenever a malicious user opens and closes a connection with the HTTP port of the server and then closes the connection immediately, the server will end with both memory and open file limits exhausted at some point, depending on the amount of memory available. 

At HTTP upgrade to remoting, the WriteTimeoutStreamSinkConduit leaks connections if RemotingConnection is closed by Remoting ServerConnectionOpenListener. Because the remoting connection originates in Undertow as part of the HTTP upgrade, there is an external layer to the remoting connection. This connection is unaware of the outermost layer when closing the connection during the connection opening procedure. Hence, the Undertow WriteTimeoutStreamSinkConduit is not notified of the closed connection in this scenario. Because WriteTimeoutStreamSinkConduit creates a timeout task, the whole dependency tree leaks via that task, which is added to XNIO WorkerThread. So, the workerThread points to the Undertow conduit, which contains the connections and causes the leak.

cves.d: A heap buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the DTLS handshake fragment reassembly logic of GnuTLS. The issue arises in merge_handshake_packet() where incoming handshake fragments are matched and merged based solely on handshake type, without validating that the message_length field remains consistent across all fragments of the same logical message. An attacker can exploit this by sending crafted DTLS fragments with conflicting message_length values, causing the implementation to allocate a buffer based on a smaller initial fragment and subsequently write beyond its bounds using larger, inconsistent fragments. Because the merge operation does not enforce proper bounds checking against the allocated buffer size, this results in an out-of-bounds write on the heap. The vulnerability is remotely exploitable without authentication via the DTLS handshake path and can lead to application crashes or potential memory corruption.

ai.summary_en: Today's security updates reveal a high-volume threat environment characterized by pervasive remote code execution, memory corruption, and authentication bypasses spanning desktop operating systems, cloud platforms, and network infrastructure. Critical vendor-specific exposures include multiple privilege escalation and code execution flaws in NVIDIA Windows GPU drivers and Tenda routers, while enterprise software faces significant risks from extensive Apache Thrift middleware vulnerabilities and Electron sandbox escapes. Additionally, the portfolio emphasizes dangers to IoT and industrial control ecosystems, active exploitation of FortiMail gateways, and widespread web application weaknesses such as server-side request forgery and stored cross-site scripting.

items.reason_en: Remote command injection in Ziroom smart home hubs allows attackers to execute system commands via manipulated syslog configuration parameters.
items.reason_zh: 自如智能家居中枢存在远程命令注入漏洞，攻击者可通过篡改syslog配置参数执行系统命令。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on critical functions allows remote actors to gain super-admin privileges, compromising IAM roles and stored integration credentials.
items.reason_zh: 关键功能缺失身份验证，使远程攻击者能够获取超级管理员权限，进而危及IAM角色与已存储的集成凭据。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the Studio Space startup validation script enables remote code execution within cloud development environments.
items.reason_zh: Studio Space启动验证脚本中存在OS命令注入漏洞，可在云开发环境中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SSRF in the webhook test endpoint is actively exploited in the wild to probe internal networks and pivot attacks.
items.reason_zh: Webhook测试端点存在未认证SSRF漏洞，已在野外被积极利用以探测内网并实施横向移动攻击。

items.reason_en: Safemode sandbox bypass enables low-privilege Foreman users to achieve remote code execution via the templating engine, risking full infrastructure takeover.
items.reason_zh: Safemode沙箱绕过漏洞使低权限Foreman用户可通过模板引擎实现远程代码执行，面临整个基础设施被接管的风险。

items.reason_en: Sandbox escape in GitLab AI Gateway allows authenticated users to break out of restricted environments and access host resources or tenant data.
items.reason_zh: GitLab AI Gateway存在沙箱逃逸漏洞，允许已认证用户突破受限环境并访问主机资源或租户数据。

items.reason_en: Webhook template validator fails to block computed member access, enabling project writers to escape sandboxes and execute arbitrary code in hosted environments.
items.reason_zh: Webhook模板验证器未能阻止计算成员访问，致使项目编写者可逃逸沙箱并在托管环境中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Incorrect character escaping in Consul Connect RBAC rules bypasses service mesh authorization, effectively breaking zero-trust network policies.
items.reason_zh: Consul Connect RBAC规则中的字符转义错误绕过了服务网格授权，实质上破坏了零信任网络策略。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication accepts global shared secrets as bearer tokens, allowing unauthorized access to cloud development workspaces and containers.
items.reason_zh: 弱身份验证机制将全局共享密钥作为Bearer令牌接受，导致未经授权即可访问云开发工作区与容器。

items.reason_en: Pexip Infinity suffers from improper input validation that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on conferencing nodes.
items.reason_zh: Pexip Infinity存在输入验证不当漏洞，允许未认证的远程攻击者在会议节点上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Dockhand's git webhook endpoints lack proper secret validation, enabling unauthenticated attackers to trigger arbitrary stack redeployments and achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Dockhand的git webhook端点缺乏适当的密钥验证，使未认证攻击者可触发任意堆栈重新部署并实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper URI encoding handling in session management allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication and gain full admin privileges.
items.reason_zh: 会话管理中URI编码处理不当，使未认证攻击者可绕过身份验证并获取完整管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Pre-authentication integer underflow in HTTP body parsing enables arbitrary code execution as root or denial of service on managed routers.
items.reason_zh: 托管路由器在 HTTP 主体解析中存在预认证整数下溢漏洞，可导致以 root 权限执行任意代码或引发拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Part of a critical hardening release addressing multiple internally discovered vulnerabilities that could compromise router and switch integrity.
items.reason_zh: 作为关键加固版本的一部分，该更新旨在修复多项内部发现的漏洞，防止路由器和交换机完整性受损。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files on FortiMail gateways, already exploited in the wild per CISA KEV.
items.reason_zh: FortiMail 网关存在路径遍历漏洞，允许未认证攻击者写入任意文件，该漏洞已被 CISA KEV 收录并遭实际利用。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated authzid parameter in ejabberd's SASL-PLAIN mechanism allows arbitrary user impersonation, compromising XMPP authentication integrity.
items.reason_zh: ejabberd 的 SASL-PLAIN 机制中未验证的 authzid 参数可导致任意用户冒充，破坏 XMPP 认证完整性。

items.reason_en: Incomplete hostname verification in Netty's QUIC certificate path prevents proper endpoint identification, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks on network traffic.
items.reason_zh: Netty 的 QUIC 证书路径中主机名验证不完整，导致无法正确进行端点标识，从而可在网络流量中实施中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Moxa protocol gateways contain a stack buffer overflow in account management interfaces, allowing authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands via crafted account names.
items.reason_zh: Moxa 协议网关的账户管理接口存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许已认证攻击者通过构造的账户名执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: ASUS routers feature externally controlled format strings in uploaded files, permitting authenticated users to execute arbitrary commands through the web management interface.
items.reason_zh: ASUS 路由器在上传文件中存在外部可控的格式化字符串漏洞，允许已认证用户通过 Web 管理界面执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution flaw in Tenda routers via the domain blocking configuration interface. Publicly available exploits drastically increase immediate threat to residential and SMB networks.
items.reason_zh: Tenda 路由器在域名屏蔽配置界面存在严重的远程代码执行漏洞。公开可用的利用工具大幅加剧了对家庭和中小企业网络的即时威胁。

items.reason_en: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in Tenda PPP edit functionality allows arbitrary code execution. Compromised routers can be used for lateral movement and network pivoting.
items.reason_zh: Tenda 的 PPP 编辑功能存在远程基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致任意代码执行。被攻陷的路由器可被用于横向移动和网络跳板攻击。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in Tenda's VoIP web management interface enables remote attackers to execute code. Directly impacts router integrity and network segmentation controls.
items.reason_zh: Tenda 的 VoIP Web 管理界面存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行代码。该漏洞直接影响路由器完整性及网络分段控制。

items.reason_en: OS command injection vulnerability in the EasyIO FS32 controller firmware allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on the device.
items.reason_zh: EasyIO FS32 控制器固件存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许攻击者在设备上执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Use of hardcoded cryptographic keys in the EasyIO FS32 device permits retrieval of embedded sensitive configuration and operational data.
items.reason_zh: EasyIO FS32 设备使用硬编码的加密密钥，导致攻击者可提取其中嵌入的敏感配置与运行数据。

items.reason_en: Enabled on-chip debug interfaces on Neo Series controllers expose common resource locations, facilitating unauthorized data collection and firmware analysis.
items.reason_zh: Neo 系列控制器上启用的片上调试接口会暴露常见资源位置，便于未经授权的数据收集与固件分析。

items.reason_en: Moxa devices fail to properly verify cryptographic signatures on firmware images, allowing privileged attackers to install malicious updates and compromise device integrity.
items.reason_zh: Moxa 设备未能正确验证固件镜像的密码学签名，允许特权攻击者安装恶意更新并破坏设备完整性。

items.reason_en: Wind River VxWorks shell evaluation occasionally skips privilege checks, allowing authenticated users to bypass security controls and execute restricted commands.
items.reason_zh: Wind River VxWorks 的 Shell 求值过程偶尔会跳过权限检查，允许已认证用户绕过安全控制并执行受限命令。

items.reason_en: Session hijack vulnerability directly leads to remote code execution as the zammad user and is actively exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: 会话劫持漏洞可直接导致以 zammad 用户身份执行远程代码，且该漏洞已在野外遭实际利用。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via a valid Internal-Key header grants remote attackers unrestricted administrative API access to the management platform.
items.reason_zh: 通过有效的 Internal-Key 头部可实现认证绕过，使远程攻击者获得对管理平台的无限制 API 管理访问权限。

items.reason_en: Directory traversal flaw in the parse_request function allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files from the hosting server.
items.reason_zh: parse_request 函数中的目录遍历漏洞允许未认证攻击者读取托管服务器上的任意文件。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in the BackupController allows authenticated panel users to read or delete arbitrary system files using encoded payloads.
items.reason_zh: BackupController 中的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证面板用户使用编码的有效载荷读取或删除任意系统文件。

items.reason_en: Prototype pollution in Tinypool replaces intended worker modules with attacker-controlled filenames, leading to arbitrary code execution in Node.js web applications.
items.reason_zh: Tinypool 的原型污染漏洞会将预期的工作进程模块替换为攻击者控制的文件名，从而导致 Node.js Web 应用程序中的任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Deserialization flaw in Seroval passes callable thenables to native Promise resolvers, enabling remote code execution during JavaScript value stringification.
items.reason_zh: Seroval 的反序列化漏洞会将可调用的 thenables 传递给原生 Promise 解析器，从而在 JavaScript 值字符串化期间实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in image-downloader allows writing downloaded response data outside configured directories, risking file system compromise via web interfaces.
items.reason_zh: image-downloader 中的路径遍历漏洞允许将下载的响应数据写入配置目录之外，存在通过 Web 接口导致文件系统被攻破的风险。

items.reason_en: DNS rebinding in Next.js Image Optimization follows attacker-controlled resolutions to private IPs, bypassing network isolation controls in modern web stacks.
items.reason_zh: Next.js 图像优化中的 DNS 重绑定漏洞会跟随攻击者控制的解析结果指向私有 IP，从而绕过现代 Web 技术栈中的网络隔离控制。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated chart formula expressions allow read-access members to recover the JavaScript Function constructor, enabling arbitrary code execution in web dashboards.
items.reason_zh: 未验证的图表公式表达式允许只读权限成员恢复 JavaScript Function 构造函数，从而在 Web 仪表板中实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in the HAVELSAN AI chatbot platform allows attackers to extract sensitive database contents or manipulate backend application logic.
items.reason_zh: HAVELSAN AI 聊天机器人平台存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许攻击者提取敏感数据库内容或操纵后端应用逻辑。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS via oEmbed photo responses in Ghost CMS allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into published blog posts viewed by readers.
items.reason_zh: Ghost CMS 中通过 oEmbed 图片响应引发的存储型 XSS 漏洞，允许攻击者向读者浏览的已发布博客文章中注入恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Paste handling in ProseMirror accepts unvalidated HTML attributes, enabling stored XSS in rich text editors commonly integrated into web applications.
items.reason_zh: ProseMirror 的粘贴处理逻辑接受未验证的 HTML 属性，导致集成于 Web 应用程序中的富文本编辑器存在存储型 XSS 风险。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in YesWiki admin API allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite configuration files and escalate privileges on web portals.
items.reason_zh: YesWiki 管理 API 存在授权绕过漏洞，允许未认证攻击者覆盖配置文件并在 Web 门户中提权。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated actor URL in YesWiki subscription sync enables SSRF attacks targeting internal hosts and cloud metadata endpoints through web forms.
items.reason_zh: YesWiki 订阅同步中未验证的 actor URL 可通过 Web 表单触发 SSRF 攻击，针对内部主机和云元数据端点。

items.reason_en: Divi Membership plugin determines user roles via insecure password verification logic, enabling unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges to administrator levels.
items.reason_zh: Divi Membership 插件通过不安全的密码验证逻辑确定用户角色，允许未认证攻击者提权至管理员级别。

items.reason_en: The same plugin accepts PayPal callbacks without IPN validation or cryptographic signature checks, allowing complete authentication bypass and unauthorized account access.
items.reason_zh: 该插件在未进行IPN验证或密码学签名检查的情况下接受PayPal回调，导致身份验证完全绕过及未授权账户访问。

items.reason_en: YesWiki concatenates unescaped filter tokens directly into SQL queries, granting unauthenticated attackers the ability to perform blind SQL injection and extract sensitive data.
items.reason_zh: YesWiki将未转义的过滤令牌直接拼接至SQL查询中，使未认证攻击者能够执行盲SQL注入并窃取敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the widely used WordPress DevKit Pro plugin allows complete administrator account takeover. Requires no valid credentials, posing immediate risk to millions of sites.
items.reason_zh: 广泛使用的WordPress DevKit Pro插件存在身份验证绕过漏洞，可导致管理员账户完全被接管。无需有效凭据即可利用，对数百万网站构成即时风险。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in JetBrains YouTrack via manipulated user group links compromises enterprise issue tracking platforms. Attackers can elevate permissions to access sensitive project data.
items.reason_zh: JetBrains YouTrack中通过操纵用户组链接可实现权限提升，危及企业问题跟踪平台。攻击者可提升权限以访问敏感项目数据。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Model Context Protocol servers enables internal network reconnaissance and restricted resource access. Highlights emerging risks in AI-driven API orchestration frameworks.
items.reason_zh: Model Context Protocol服务器中的服务端请求伪造漏洞可启用内部网络侦察和受限资源访问。凸显了AI驱动API编排框架中的新兴风险。

items.reason_en: Database initialization assigns a fixed vendor password to the superuser account, allowing any attacker with OS access to authenticate and compromise the database.
items.reason_zh: 数据库初始化时为超级用户账户分配了固定的厂商密码，使任何拥有操作系统访问权限的攻击者均可认证成功并破坏数据库。

items.reason_en: Race condition in LDAP connection handling causes worker thread starvation, leading to denial of service for directory services.
items.reason_zh: LDAP连接处理中的竞态条件会导致工作线程饥饿，进而引发目录服务拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in the asset group search query builder allows authenticated users to inject malicious SQL statements into PostgreSQL queries.
items.reason_zh: 资产组搜索查询构建器中存在SQL注入漏洞，允许已认证用户向PostgreSQL查询中注入恶意SQL语句。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow and integer overflow in core Apache Thrift library enable remote code execution in any service utilizing the RPC framework.
items.reason_zh: 核心Apache Thrift库中的堆缓冲区溢出和整数溢出漏洞可使利用该RPC框架的任何服务发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow and out-of-bounds write in Thrift C++ bindings can corrupt memory structures, leading to crashes or exploitation in backend services.
items.reason_zh: Thrift C++绑定中的整数下溢和越界写入可破坏内存结构，导致后端服务崩溃或被利用。

items.reason_en: NULL pointer dereference in Thrift PHP bindings can cause service instability or unexpected behavior in web-facing microservice architectures.
items.reason_zh: Thrift PHP绑定中的空指针解引用可导致面向Web的微服务架构出现服务不稳定或意外行为。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow from unchecked payload length allocation in Thrift WebSocket transports enables remote code execution in affected middleware services.
items.reason_zh: Thrift WebSocket传输层中未检查负载长度分配导致的堆溢出漏洞，可使受影响的中间件服务发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow and integer overflow in Thrift PHP bindings enable potential remote code execution in legacy web applications relying on Thrift.
items.reason_zh: Thrift PHP绑定中的栈缓冲区溢出和整数溢出漏洞可在依赖Thrift的遗留Web应用中导致潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in Thrift Go transports leads to stack exhaustion and denial of service when handling malformed framed frames in middleware.
items.reason_zh: Thrift Go传输层在处理中间件中格式错误的帧时，因不受控制的递归导致栈耗尽和拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: SurrealDB constructs HTTP sessions using mismatched authentication headers without validating permissions, allowing attackers to bypass authorization controls.
items.reason_zh: SurrealDB使用不匹配的认证头构建HTTP会话且未验证权限，允许攻击者绕过授权控制。

items.reason_en: Apache Thrift Perl bindings suffer from uncaught exceptions during request processing, which can lead to service crashes or information leakage in distributed middleware architectures.
items.reason_zh: Apache Thrift Perl绑定在请求处理过程中存在未捕获异常，可能导致分布式中间件架构中的服务崩溃或信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Causes denial of service via memory exhaustion when malicious clients rapidly cycle connections on Wildfly's HTTP client protocol. Impacts Java application server stability and availability.
items.reason_zh: 当恶意客户端在Wildfly的HTTP客户端协议上快速循环连接时，会通过内存耗尽导致拒绝服务。影响Java应用服务器的稳定性和可用性。

items.reason_en: Memory allocation with excessive size values in OpenPGP parsers allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger denial of service via crafted signatures.
items.reason_zh: OpenPGP解析器中使用过大值进行内存分配，使未认证攻击者能够通过构造的签名触发拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in the ASN.1 parser causes stack exhaustion when processing deeply nested constructed elements.
items.reason_zh: ASN.1解析器中的不受控递归在处理深度嵌套的构造元素时会导致栈耗尽。

items.reason_en: Shell injection vulnerability in the Docker release pipeline allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands by manipulating repository name configurations.
items.reason_zh: Docker发布流水线中的Shell注入漏洞允许攻击者通过操纵仓库名称配置来执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Timing side-channel in Bouncy Castle's NTRU implementation could leak secret keys, compromising cryptographic security in Java-based applications.
items.reason_zh: Bouncy Castle的NTRU实现中存在时序侧信道漏洞，可能泄露密钥，破坏基于Java的应用程序的加密安全性。

items.reason_en: Insecure permissions on shared Unix domain sockets in Nx monorepo tool allow local privilege escalation or information leakage between unprivileged accounts.
items.reason_zh: Nx monorepo工具中共享Unix域套接字的不安全权限可导致非特权账户间发生本地权限提升或信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Malformed PDF forces inefficient byte-by-byte decompression in pypdf, causing severe denial of service in document processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 格式错误的PDF迫使pypdf进行低效的逐字节解压，导致文档处理流水线出现严重拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in GPAC's DASH client URL resolution allows remote attackers to crash media streaming applications or potentially execute code.
items.reason_zh: GPAC的DASH客户端URL解析中存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者使媒体流应用程序崩溃或潜在地执行代码。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated coinbase scriptSig reading in Zebra allows dropping blocks without peer penalties, potentially disrupting blockchain synchronization and node health.
items.reason_zh: Zebra中未验证coinbase scriptSig读取允许丢弃区块而不对等节点进行惩罚，可能破坏区块链同步和节点健康。

items.reason_en: AgentDeskAI browser-tools-mcp contains an OS command injection flaw in its server connector, enabling remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
items.reason_zh: AgentDeskAI browser-tools-mcp在其服务器连接器中包含OS命令注入缺陷，使远程攻击者能够执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Eclipse ThreadX modules can clear the Memory Protection Unit (MPU) enable bit, removing isolation boundaries and allowing unprivileged threads to read/write arbitrary kernel memory.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse ThreadX模块可清除内存保护单元（MPU）启用位，移除隔离边界，并使非特权线程能够读写任意内核内存。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in GnuTLS RSA-PSK implementation allows attackers to impersonate users by injecting NUL characters into usernames. Undermines mutual TLS security models.
items.reason_zh: GnuTLS RSA-PSK实现中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许攻击者通过在用户名中注入NUL字符冒充用户，破坏了双向TLS安全模型。

items.reason_en: Insufficient bounds validation in libaom's AV1 encoder allows crafted video frames to trigger remote code execution. Affects media processing pipelines and streaming infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: libaom的AV1编码器中边界验证不足，允许构造的视频帧触发远程代码执行。影响媒体处理流水线和流媒体基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in Red Hat libsolv during package repository decompression enables potential code execution. Threatens system integrity when processing malicious RPM/dependency files.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat libsolv在软件包仓库解压过程中存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能导致代码执行。在处理恶意RPM/依赖文件时威胁系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Poppler's PDF renderer leads to undersized heap allocations and out-of-bounds writes. Malicious PDFs can trigger memory corruption in document viewers and email gateways.
items.reason_zh: Poppler的PDF渲染器存在整数溢出漏洞，会导致堆分配空间不足及越界写入。恶意PDF文件可触发文档查看器和邮件网关中的内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Certificate validation bypass in GnuTLS due to oversized Subject Alternative Name handling undermines TLS trust chains. Enables man-in-the-middle attacks against secured services.
items.reason_zh: GnuTLS因对过大的Subject Alternative Name处理不当导致证书验证绕过，破坏了TLS信任链。该漏洞使得针对安全服务的中间人攻击成为可能。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow during GnuTLS DTLS handshake fragment reassembly allows remote memory corruption. Compromises real-time secure communication protocols like VoIP and QUIC.
items.reason_zh: GnuTLS在DTLS握手分片重组过程中存在堆溢出漏洞，可导致远程内存损坏。该问题会危及VoIP和QUIC等实时安全通信协议。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary memory write in libaom via crafted AV1 pixel data enables severe exploitation of video encoding workflows. Directly impacts media servers and cloud transcoding services.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造的AV1像素数据可在libaom中实现任意内存写入，导致视频编码工作流面临严重利用风险。该漏洞直接影响媒体服务器与云转码服务。
